card.name: Partway through medical terms and numbers
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle piece of a split medical term or number, such as the 0 in an iodine concentration like 270 mg Iodine/mL, or the clot in clotting factor. It also fires inside names like Clotrimazole and pancreas divisum.

modes.label: Iodine strengths
modes.description: The digit 0 inside a number such as 270 or 320 before mg Iodine/mL.

modes.label: Clotting terms
modes.description: The start of clotting or clot-like words, as in clotting factor replacement or Clotrimazole.
modes.example: Evaluate for coagulopathy and consider<< clot>>ting factor replacement as needed

modes.label: Other split medical words
modes.description: Middle pieces of words like pancreas, platelet, or multidetector.
